text.autoconfig.simplevault.title: Simple Vault
text.autoconfig.simplevault.option.vault: A rare gap in the Overworld bedrock leads into the Bedrock Vault: quiet halls below the bedrock, enclosed by bedrock, a way out only through its riddles. Off: no new gaps, existing gates do nothing. Default: on.
One in this many new Overworld chunks (0-100000, 0 = none) gets a 2 x 2 gap through the bedrock floor with the Vault Gate at its bottom. Default: 400.
Seconds after the first entry until the inner gate seals behind the players (5-600). Until then it leads back out; once nobody is inside it opens again. Default: 30.
Volume of the quiet, random sounds in the Bedrock Vault in percent (0-100, 0 = silent); a drip or a far chime every 30-90 s. The Ambient slider applies too. Default: 40.
item.simplevault.seal_fragment.tooltip: Fits only the altar of its own vault

message.simplevault.vault.path_fade: The path goes dark - follow the light on the ceiling

simplevault.guide.page.1.title: Simple Vault
simplevault.guide.page.1: The Bedrock Vault: far below, a rare gap in the Overworld bedrock leads into quiet halls enclosed by bedrock.
simplevault.guide.page.2.title: Simple Vault
simplevault.guide.page.2: The gate closes behind you - three riddles give three seal parts, and the Ascent Altar carries you back up.
simplevault.guide.page.3.title: The Bedrock Vault
simplevault.guide.page.3: Far below, a rare 2 x 2 gap leads through the Overworld bedrock (config vault.gapRarity, one chunk in 400); an old ladder hangs in it and rising motes glow at its bottom: the Vault Gate.
simplevault.guide.page.4.title: The Bedrock Vault
simplevault.guide.page.4: Step in and you arrive in the Bedrock Vault, quiet halls on two floors in a dimension of solid bedrock.
simplevault.guide.page.5.title: The three riddles
simplevault.guide.page.5: Three chambers each hold a riddle; a froglight above the door shows its colour. Light (yellow):
simplevault.guide.page.6.title: The three riddles
simplevault.guide.page.6: five levers switch the lamps above them - each lever its own lamp and the next one; set them so the lamps show the mural above. Sound (violet):
simplevault.guide.page.7.title: The three riddles
simplevault.guide.page.7: strike the four crystals in the order of the frieze, left to right. Path (green): cross the tiles where the lichen glows on the ceiling.
simplevault.guide.page.8.title: The ascent
simplevault.guide.page.8: Set the three seal parts into the sockets of the Ascent Altar (yellow, violet, green). The seal in the dome gives way, a reward drops on the altar and a stream rises:
simplevault.guide.page.9.title: The ascent
simplevault.guide.page.9: step onto the altar and it carries you up the shaft to the Overworld surface above the place you came in. The vault stays solved.
